titleEn: Royal Decree No. 0822/1008 on the establishment of Phnom Tamao protected wildlife park and botanical garden

articles.en:
- The Phnom Tamao zoo, protected forest and botanical garden is hereby established with the aim of ensuring the sustainability of the care and conservation of forests and wildlife, the rescue, treatment and rehabilitation of wildlife, education, dissemination, study and research, and tourism services.
[Illegible in source]

- This Royal Decree has the following objectives: - to develop a botanical garden containing precious and economically valuable tree species; - to develop it into a national, cultural and historical tourism destination; - to provide care, rescue, treatment and rehabilitation of wildlife; - to promote the reproduction of wildlife, and of rare and endangered animal and plant species; - to serve as a basis for study, research and dissemination on the interaction between humans, wildlife and forests; - to create green space and enhance the well-being of the area; - to promote the conservation of plant and wildlife genetic resources and the sustainable development of natural resources.

- The Phnom Tamao zoo, protected forest and botanical garden has a total area of 2,025
(two thousand and twenty-five) hectares situated in the geography of Bati District, Takeo Province, as shown in the map indicating the location and coordinates annexed to this Royal Decree.
The Phnom Tamao zoo, protected forest and botanical garden shall be divided into 3 zones as follows:
1- The protected forest zone for the rehabilitation of wildlife: a zone to ensure the reproduction of wildlife and the conservation and sustainable development of natural resources, with an area of 1,021 (one thousand and twenty-one) hectares.
2- The Phnom Tamao precious timber botanical garden zone: a zone to ensure the care of saplings and the development of a botanical garden with precious tree species and aesthetic value, with an area of 530 (five hundred and thirty) hectares.
3- The Phnom Tamao zoo zone: a zone for the care of wildlife, the treatment and rescue of wildlife, education and dissemination, and the provision of tourism services, with an area of 474 (four hundred and seventy-four) hectares.
- The organisation and functioning of the Phnom Tamao zoo, protected forest and botanical garden shall be determined by sub-decree.

- The Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries shall be responsible for managing the Phnom Tamao zoo, protected forest and botanical garden area and shall prepare a management plan for the zoo, protected forest and botanical garden so as to ensure effective and sustainable management and development.
[Illegible in source]; any provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.
Article 7. - Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for implementing this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards.
